rows.text: Confirms annual earnings guidance range of $10.66 to $10.96 per diluted share, and adjusted diluted earnings guidance range of $10.87 to $11.17 per share including $0.02 of year-to-date ASU 2016-09 tax benefits

Adjusting for the impact from Accounting Standards Update (ASU) 2016-09, Improvements to Employee Share-Based Payment Accounting , earnings per diluted share was $3.40 in the third quarter of 2026 compared to $3.39 in the same period of 2025.

Provides US GAAP annual earnings guidance range of $10.66 to $10.96 per diluted share, which includes $0.02 of year-to-date ASU 2016-09 tax benefits and $0.21 of CEO transition costs; excluding CEO transition costs, confirms prior annual earnings guidance range of $10.87 to $11.17 per diluted share
